name: Feedback and status
description: Telling people what happened and what is happening. Every state here is carried by words first; symbol and colour reinforce.

components.name: Alert
components.anatomy: An inline banner with a semantic symbol, a title, body text and optional actions.
components.material: Haze surface with the semantic ink pair on the symbol well
components.geometry: Content radius; 12px minimum from content to the feathered edge
components.semantics: role=alert only for genuinely urgent, interrupting content; otherwise a plain region
components.crystal: Surface, symbol well, semantic pairs, action placement
components.product: The message, severity and any recovery action

components.name: Toast
components.anatomy: A transient floating Resin notification with a message and an optional single action.
components.material: Resin with Haze reading fill and the clearest floating shadow
components.geometry: Content radius; stacked with a 12px offset
components.semantics: Polite live region; an urgent toast is assertive. Auto-dismiss must never remove the only route to an action.
components.crystal: Surface, stacking, entry and exit motion
components.product: Message, duration policy, queueing and the action

components.name: Notification
components.anatomy: A persistent, dismissible message with a title, body, timestamp and actions.
components.material: Resin surface with Haze reading fill
components.semantics: Announced politely; the dismiss control is named for what it dismisses

components.name: Progress
components.anatomy: A determinate or indeterminate track showing work in flight.
components.material: Primary fill on a primary-soft track
components.geometry: 8px track at pill radius, matching the slider track
components.semantics: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow when determinate; indeterminate omits the value rather than faking one
components.crystal: Track, fill, indeterminate motion and reduced-motion fallback
components.product: Real progress. Never simulate progress for work that is not measurable.

components.name: Ring progress
components.anatomy: A circular track with a filled arc and an optional centre label.
components.material: Primary arc on a primary-soft ring
components.geometry: Stroke matches the icon stroke weight family; label is tabular
components.semantics: Shared with Progress; the centre label is not the only representation

components.name: Loader
components.semantics: Accompanied by text saying what is loading; reduced motion replaces spin with a static, still-legible state
components.product: When it appears and what it describes

components.name: Skeleton
components.anatomy: Placeholder shapes matching the layout of content that is loading.
components.material: Haze fill with a slow luminance sweep
components.geometry: Matches the real content's radius and rhythm exactly
components.semantics: aria-hidden with a live region announcing loading; must not be read as content
components.crystal: Fill, sweep, reduced-motion fallback, resolve transition
components.note: A skeleton must match the real layout. A skeleton that does not resolve into the shape it promised is a worse experience than a spinner.

components.name: Loading overlay
components.anatomy: A scrim over a region with a centred activity mark, blocking interaction.
components.semantics: Blocked content is inert; focus does not enter it; the reason is announced
components.product: When the region blocks and for how long

components.name: Empty state
components.anatomy: An explanation of why a region is empty, with the action that would fill it.
components.geometry: Content radius; centred within its region
components.semantics: Real text; never an illustration alone. No-results and truly-empty are different states and read differently.

components.name: Result
components.anatomy: A full-region outcome with a status symbol, title, explanation and next actions.
components.material: Haze panel with the semantic ink pair on the symbol
components.semantics: The outcome is stated in the heading; symbol and colour reinforce it
components.product: The outcome, explanation and recovery routes

components.name: Inline confirm
components.anatomy: A small popover asking for confirmation next to the control that triggered it.
components.material: Resin popover with Haze reading fill
components.geometry: Content radius; anchored to the trigger
components.semantics: Focus moves into the popover, returns to the trigger on dismiss, and Escape cancels
components.product: The consequence, its wording and whether a full dialog is warranted instead
components.note: Consequential and irreversible actions belong in a dialog, not an inline confirm.

components.name: Tour
components.anatomy: A sequence of steps that points at parts of the interface.
components.material: Frost step panel over a Mirage scrim
components.geometry: Panel keeps panel radius; the highlight follows the target's own radius.
components.semantics: Focus moves to each step; the sequence is escapable and its position is announced.
components.crystal: Panel and scrim material, step motion, focus management

components.name: Semi-circle progress
components.anatomy: A half-ring showing progress toward a value.
components.material: Haze track with a primary arc
components.geometry: Stroke matches the ring progress contract.
components.semantics: role="progressbar" with a text value beside it.

components.name: Meter group
components.anatomy: Several proportions shown on one bar.
components.geometry: Track keeps the content radius; segments meet without gaps.
components.semantics: Each segment is labelled; meaning never rests on colour alone.
components.crystal: Track and segment materials, legend, label association
